title: Genus-2 Height Batch Performance
objective: Batch uncached genus-2 local height recurrences, exact outward logarithms, and proof publication so cold rank-2/rank-4 pairings approach the Phase-7 Magma gate without weakening certificates.

handoff.summary: Added bounded point-major modular, outward dyadic, exact two-step, and exact integer atanh-log kernels with same-source fallbacks. The closure-owned height proof path now deduplicates uncached diagonal/sum points, shares model preparation, validates fresh Kummer coordinates/tables/bounds/oracles, supports stage-boundary cancellation, and atomically publishes detached authenticated records before the unchanged warm pairing/regulator path. Exact log endpoints use separate input/output dyadic precision with monotone power-of-two reduction, an explicit positive-series geometric remainder, and exact floor/ceiling publication. Local standard-fixture timings improved to about 0.60-0.74s rank 2 and 1.63s rank 4, but honestly miss the 0.18/0.50s prototype floors and Phase-7 <=2x Magma cold gate.
risks: Cold rank-2/rank-4 pairing remains approximately 15x/8.6x slower than the historical 40ms/190ms resident Magma rows; no competitive claim or new bench-1 receipt is made.
Production integration must add four functions to genus2-kummer-height-production and resolve hyperelliptic-curves-kernels source budget 185106 > 175000 by 10106 bytes.
Only linux-x64 was run locally; production-pack integration must repeat native/dynamic differentials on linux-arm64, windows-x64, and macos-arm64.
next_steps: Obtain an independent proof/correctness audit of exact log rounding, hidden proof publication, cancellation atomicity, and cache provenance before integration.

Extend architecture/native-kernels.json with modular_kummer_height_recurrence_batch, dyadic_kummer_height_recurrence_batch, exact_kummer_small_step_batch, and dyadic_log_interval_batch, then resolve the package byte budget and rerun pnpm architecture:check.
Profile and reduce the remaining 0.32-0.65s per-batch RealBall/result/diagnostic assembly and repeated closure cache restoration; do not request bench-1 until local rank2/rank4 approach 0.18/0.50s.
